symbol_descriptions: Initial velocity subject to substrate inhibition
derivation_notes: Derived from the Haldane substrate-inhibition model, extending Michaelis-Menten kinetics with a nonproductive secondary substrate-binding term S^2/Ksi that suppresses velocity at high S, producing a peaked v-S curve.
scenario_text: An enzyme is subject to substrate inhibition, where excess substrate binds a secondary site and suppresses catalysis. Independent assays measure instantaneous velocity across a broad substrate range. Velocity rises, peaks at an intermediate substrate level, then declines at very high substrate. Each measurement corresponds to a distinct prepared substrate condition.
